Dishonest staff let the restaurant down
Jul 2026 • Couples
We booked a table on the balcony and it was exceptional. Food was delicious and we planned to book again for our final night in Hanoi. When it was time to pay our bill we moved downstairs as other customers had done. One of the servers (a young Vietnamese guy with a dodgy cockney accent) told us he would bring the card machine to us. No problems still, payment went through and he said you don’t need a receipt do you? We replied yes we do. On checking the receipt we were over charged 135000 dong. When we asked about this he responded with sorry sorry and gave us the over charge in cash.
Needless to say even though the food was delicious we would never ever visit this restaurant again. Dishonest, dodgy and deceitful.
We had full intentions of leaving a tip in cash but after this incident walked away with a very sour experience. I would not recommend this restaurant as staff are blatantly dishonest and try to deceive well intentioned customers . Sad and disappointed customers.

Absolutely a must!
Jul 2026 • Solo
DON DUCK @donduck_hanoi 

My first dinner at DON DUCK was a few years ago, and it immediately stood apart for its clear identity. Returning since then has only confirmed that this is far more than a restaurant built around a single ingredient. The philosophy is simple yet remarkably well executed: celebrate duck in all its versatility while maintaining consistency and respect for quality throughout the menu.

The dining room is relaxed and welcoming, creating an atmosphere where the focus naturally shifts to the food. What continues to impress me is the remarkable variety of duck preparations, each reflecting careful technique and an understanding of how differently the same ingredient can be expressed. The kitchen shows equal attention to everything surrounding the main attraction, with meats cooked beautifully, vegetables retaining freshness and texture, and a mashed potato so smooth and well-balanced that it deserves a mention of its own.

Service remains genuinely warm, attentive, and efficient, contributing to an experience that feels as comfortable as it is satisfying.

DON DUCK proves that a focused concept, when backed by skill, consistency, and genuine passion, can become one of Hanoi’s most rewarding dining experiences.

reviews.review_text:
Katie
Castleford, United Kingdom212 contributions

Give this is try if you love duck!
Apr 2026 • Couples
We were excited to visit this duck-specialist restaurant after hearing the buzz and seeing the Michelin recommendation. The food is genuinely good and we left satisfied, but I wouldn’t say it’s mind-blowing.

We went big on the menu to try a range of dishes:

The grilled duck on the table (coconut galangal spiced) was the surprise star of the meal. We were the least excited about ordering it, but it turned out to be the standout – fragrant and flavourful.

The duck breast was also excellent – perfectly cooked, tender, and tasty. My only complaint is that the portion of sauce was tiny for the amount of duck, mash, and vegetables on the plate. A bit more sauce would have taken it from great to excellent.

The half roasted duck was decent (crispy skin etc) but not outstanding. The way it was cut left the bones in awkward shards, which made it quite hard and messy to eat. It might be worth asking the staff if you can have it uncut so you can pick your way around the bones more easily.

The duck salad with pear was pleasant and fresh, but I feel it could have been elevated with bolder seasoning.

The restaurant itself is lovely. We sat on the balcony overlooking the street, which was perfect for people-watching – you get the energy of Hanoi without being in the thick of the traffic and noise. The inside rooms are also pleasant, but I’d avoid the back room if possible; the atmosphere there felt pretty flat.

Service was friendly, attentive, and warm throughout. And for the amount of food we ordered, the price was excellent value.

Verdict: I would happily come back, just not straight away given the amount of restaurants there are to sample in Hanoi. And I would recommend it to anyone who hasn’t tried it yet, especially if you're are a duck lover!

Outstanding Service in the Heart of Hanoi’s Old Quarter
Jan 2026 • Couples
We had duck at this restaurant and the food was absolutely delicious, well cooked and full of flavor.
However, what truly impressed us the most was the service.

The restaurant is located in the old, very chaotic quarter of Hanoi, and after the noise and confusion of the streets, stepping inside felt like a small oasis of calm. The staff was incredibly kind, attentive, and welcoming from the very first moment. They made us feel genuinely cared for, always smiling and making sure everything was perfect.

Because of their kindness and attention, we couldn’t leave without writing this review.
Highly recommended—not only for the food, but especially for the wonderful people who work there.
